title: Cook Instant Ramen Noodle Soup
summary: Prepare a packet of Maruchan chicken ramen: gather the packet, bowl and pot, boil water, cook the noodles, stir in the seasoning, and serve in a bowl.

nodes.name: Get ramen packet from drawer
nodes.instruction_novice: Take one packet of ramen out of the drawer. Close the drawer when you're done.
nodes.end_state: A ramen packet is in hand and the drawer is closed.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get ramen packet from drawer?

nodes.name: Gather bowl, plate and pot
nodes.instruction_novice: Get a bowl to eat from and a small pot for boiling. Set them near the stove.
nodes.end_state: A bowl and a pot sit on or beside the stove.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather bowl, plate and pot?

nodes.name: Add water to pot
nodes.instruction_novice: Fill the pot with about two cups of water. Place it on a burner.
nodes.end_state: A pot with water sits on a stove burner.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add water to pot?

nodes.name: Bring water to a boil
nodes.instruction_novice: Turn the burner to high. Wait until the water is bubbling strongly.
nodes.end_state: The water in the pot is at a rolling boil.

checks.question: Is this step done: Bring water to a boil?

nodes.name: Open packet, remove seasoning
nodes.instruction_novice: Tear open the ramen packet. Take out the small seasoning sachet and set it aside.
nodes.end_state: The noodle block is exposed and the seasoning sachet lies separately.

checks.question: Is this step done: Open packet, remove seasoning?

nodes.name: Add noodles to boiling water
nodes.instruction_novice: Gently drop the noodle block into the boiling water. Be careful not to splash.
nodes.end_state: The noodle block is submerged in the boiling water.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add noodles to boiling water?

nodes.name: Cook noodles three minutes
nodes.instruction_novice: Let the noodles cook for about three minutes. Stir and break them apart with a fork as they soften.
nodes.end_state: The noodles are loose, soft and separated in the pot.

checks.question: Is this step done: Cook noodles three minutes?

nodes.name: Turn off heat, add seasoning
nodes.instruction_novice: Turn off the burner. Empty the seasoning packet into the pot and stir well.
nodes.end_state: The burner is off and the broth is evenly golden.

checks.question: Is this step done: Turn off heat, add seasoning?

nodes.name: Pour ramen into bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Carefully pour the noodles and broth into your bowl. Use a pot holder if the handle is hot.
nodes.end_state: The bowl holds noodles and broth and the pot is empty.

checks.question: Is this step done: Pour ramen into bowl?

nodes.name: Serve and clean up
nodes.instruction_novice: Bring your bowl to the table to eat. Put the pot in the sink and throw away the wrapper.
nodes.end_state: The ramen bowl is served and the stovetop is clear.

checks.question: Is this step done: Serve and clean up?
